name: Assistance for Purchase of Educational Instruments for Medical, Engineering and Technical Diploma Courses
benefit: > **Financial Assistance Amounts:** - Medical Students: ₹15,000 annually. - Engineering Students: ₹10,000 annually. - Diploma Students: ₹5,000 annually.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) examination. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized medical, engineering, or technical diploma course. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.
